name: Ring of Bounce, Greater
body:
Aura moderate transmutation; CL 7th; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

As a ring of bounce. The wearer still receives the +10 bonus to Acrobatics checks for jumping, but all other Acrobatics checks are made at a -10 penalty.

The ring can be removed freely.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of jumping, improved

Identification DC 32
False Identification DC 22
